subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@opensight.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@opensight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline

Hi Samantha / Daniel,

Thanks for taking the time last week. Per our conversation I'd like to kick off a formal mutual action plan (MAP) to align on evaluation scope, acceptance criteria, and a close timeline for reserving a dedicated GPU pool for OpenSight's realtime inference use case. High-level goals for the MAP:

- Provision a Dedicated GPU pool sized to sustain 200 rps peak for model v1 with P90 generation latency <= 350 ms (90-token average).
- Run an evaluation plan (functional + perf) against your sample prompts and the obfuscated dataset you provided.
- Agree on pass/fail criteria and a contract milestone to reserve capacity by the end of August.

I've attached a first-pass evaluation plan (Redwood_MAP_EvalPlan_v1.pdf) that lays out the test matrix (cold vs warm KV cache, sequence lengths, batch sizes) and acceptance criteria. Proposed MAP cadence: 6 weeks for evaluation + 1 week for procurement/contract finalization. If that looks tight on your side, we can stretch to 8 weeks.

Can you confirm the internal owners on your side (Engineering lead, Infra/Cloud, Procurement) and if you have any blackout dates in August? Also, please confirm whether A100 80GB is acceptable or if you require H100 nodes for initial testing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-min kickoff this week to confirm attendees and timeline.
2) Share evaluation dataset (obfuscated) + security questionnaire answers.
3) Redwood to schedule perf run window and share runbook.

Attendees from our side: Marissa (Solutions), Rishi (AE), Markus (Head of Sales Ops).

Thanks,

Grace
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_EvalPlan_v1.pdf
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@opensight.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@opensight.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline

Thanks Grace — this looks good.

On Tue, 3 Aug 2026 at 15:12, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samantha / Daniel,
> 
> Thanks for taking the time last week. Per our conversation I'd like to kick off a formal mutual action plan (MAP)...

We can own Engineering (Daniel Park, infra lead) and Procurement (I'll loop in Legal shortly). Proposed internal attendees: Daniel Park (Eng Lead), Priya Shen (Infra), and myself for procurement. I will also add our product manager for acceptance criteria.

OpenSight prefers H100 for initial perf runs — we've seen better single-GPU throughput with our model topologies. If H100 is required we may need a slightly longer slot for cluster warm-up.

Available slots for a kickoff: Wed 6 Aug 14:00–15:00 ET, Thu 7 Aug 10:00–10:30 ET, or Fri 8 Aug 11:30–12:00 ET. Please pick what works for you.

I've attached our security questionnaire for your team (opensight_security_q23.pdf). We'll also share an obfuscated eval dataset after the kickoff.

Thanks,
Samantha Lewis
Head of ML Platforms
OpenSight AI

Attachments: opensight_security_q23.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@opensight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline

Thanks Samantha — H100 preference noted. Quick notes on the perf side that I want to lock down before kickoff:

- Target throughput/latency matrix: 200 rps peak; 95th-token P90 <= 350 ms; tail latencies measured at 99th for service SLOs.
- We'll run the perf matrix across node configs: 4x H100 (NVL or DGX-style), 8x A100 80GB (if you want to test a cheaper config), and a quantized int8 fallback for cost checks.
- Perf runs will include warm-up runs for KV cache; please plan for 4–6 hours of dedicated cluster time per run.

I'll add the GPU_pool_spec_sheet.xlsx to the shared Drive so you can see our recommended pool shapes. Grace — tagging you for runbook ownership. Rishi — once Samantha confirms procurement owners, can you own pricing/commit terms?

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Related doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-OpenSight-MAP

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline

Appreciate the confirm, Samantha. I'll coordinate procurement cadence and provide an initial commercial proposal tied to the MAP milestones. Deal id RW-2026-OS-9845.

High level commercial notes:
- Reserved pool pricing will be presented as monthly committed nodes + burst credits.
- We can structure a trial discount that converts to a committed discount if capacity is reserved by 2026-08-31.

I will follow up with an early draft Term Sheet ahead of the kickoff that lists commit sizes, expected monthly tokens, and an outline of cancellation/scale rules.

Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@opensight.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool + evaluation & close timeline

Folks — looping in to ensure we get capacity reservation on track. A couple of operational asks before kickoff:

1) If OpenSight requires H100 for validation, we should block an H100 cluster for the week of Aug 16–20 for perf runs; that gives us time to prep and warm caches.
2) Proposed initial reservation: 8 H100 GPUs (2 nodes) with an automatic scale policy to 16 GPUs during peak test windows. This is our recommended shape to hit the 200 rps target.
3) Please upload SOC2 and audit artifacts to the Drive link so Legal can pre-check; we've seen procurement pushbacks if SOC2 is not available up front.

Samantha — if you can confirm the procurement/legal contacts I can fast-track a SOC2 package and draft the reservation contract.

-Markus
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

S.
